build_project: build a given project and its dependencies using getdeps build with optional clean and cache flags
fetch_project_sources: fetch the source code for a project and its transitive dependencies using getdeps fetch
install_system_deps: install system packages to satisfy project dependencies using getdeps install-system-deps with recursive option
test_project: test a given project with optional test filters, retries, and testpilot settings using getdeps test
generate_github_actions: generate GitHub Actions configuration YAML files for Linux, macOS, and Windows using getdeps generate-github-actions
